title: Shared-module migration tooling and codemod support
problemStatement: The shared-module adoption and hoisting program is producing repeated import-path migrations, especially where temporary tools/shared wrappers now have canonical src/shared owners. Without a reusable codemod, those changes would keep being done by hand and drift in review quality and completeness.

duplicateClusters.name: Wrapper-to-canonical import rewrites
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Create one manifest-driven codemod that rewrites exact shared-module import specifiers and can be run in dry-run, check, or write mode.

whyCurrentSharedModulesWereInsufficient: The repo had stable shared destinations for some migrations, but no reusable automation for updating imports consistently.
The existing review and scan artifacts identified migration seams, but they were not directly executable.

migrationsCompleted.notes: Manifest-driven codemod for exact-specifier shared-module migrations with dry-run, check, JSON summary, and write modes.
Defines the first migration recipes for current wrapper-to-canonical shared-module paths.

nonGoals: Infer arbitrary semantic rewrites outside exact-specifier migrations.
Automatically delete local helpers in the same pass without human review.
Replace manual review for migrations that require argument-shape or behavioral changes.
followOnDeletionTargets: Add more recipes only when scans prove the migration seam is stable and repeated.
Use the codemod to retire remaining wrapper imports as H31/H32 reduction work proceeds.
